def checkout(order):
    items = order["items"]
    subtotal = 0
    for item in items:
        price = int(item["price"])
        qty = int(item.get("qty", 1))
        subtotal += price * qty
    discount = 0
    if order.get("coupon") == "SPRING":
        discount += subtotal // 20
    member = order.get("member", False)
    days_late = int(order.get("days_late", 0))
    blocked = False
    if member:
        if days_late <= 14:
            discount += subtotal // 10
        else:
            blocked = True
    shipping = 0 if subtotal > 50 else 5
    total = subtotal - discount + shipping
    return {"total": total, "blocked": blocked, "discount": discount}
